title: vicia angustifolia f. hortensis
intro: Vicia angustifolia f. hortensis, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Vetch, is a flowering plant species within the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Vicia angustifolia f. hortensis include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
